sn46.21:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā ekām antaṃ nisīdi || || 3. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn46.21:2.2: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante Bhojjhaṅgā ti vuccantī ti || ||
sn46.21:2.3: Bodhāya saṃvattantīti kho bhikkhu || tasmā Bhojjhaṅgāti vuccanti || || 3.
sn46.21:2.5: la || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti vivekanissitam virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇamiṃ || || 4.
